name: Open data platform mobility Switzerland
description: Swiss national OJP 2.0 journey planning, GTFS static timetable, GTFS Realtime trip updates, and SIRI Situation Exchange feeds for transit alerts across all of Switzerland

dataSources.purpose: Swiss-wide transit data — stop search, departure/arrival boards, journey planning with intermediate stops and polylines, live trip updates, service alerts, optional itinerary fares and formation/composition info
dataSources.dataSent: Stop names or coordinates with search radius; origin and destination stops, date and time for journey planning; trip ID for live updates; bounding box for service alerts; itinerary reference for fares; train number and date for formation
dataSources.dataReceived: Swiss stops with coordinates and modes; departures/arrivals with delays, platforms, and cancellations; journeys with leg-level GeoJSON polylines; real-time trip updates; planned and unplanned service alerts; fare summaries; vehicle formations

dataSources.purpose: OpenStreetMap-derived route geometry surfaced within the Swiss OJP routing output; provided only as attribution for OSM-backed leg polylines
dataSources.dataSent: No data — OpenMapX never contacts OpenStreetMap for this; the geometry arrives inside the Swiss OJP journey response and OSM is credited only as the underlying source
dataSources.dataReceived: Route leg geometry (polylines) embedded in the Swiss OJP journey planning response, derived from OpenStreetMap base data

dataSources.purpose: GTFS static timetable for Switzerland — schedule, route, trip, shape and stop data used to reconstruct route patterns and stop sequences
dataSources.dataSent: No user data — the published GTFS dataset is downloaded server-side as a scheduled bulk feed and imported into the database; no end-user query is forwarded
dataSources.dataReceived: The complete Swiss GTFS feed (agencies, routes, trips, stops, stop times, shapes)

dataSources.purpose: GTFS Realtime Service Alerts (-sa) — service disruption and alert messages mapped to affected stops and routes
dataSources.dataSent: No user data — the whole GTFS-RT Service Alerts protobuf feed is downloaded server-side using an API token; no end-user data is transmitted
dataSources.dataReceived: GTFS-RT FeedMessage with alert entities (header/description text, effect, severity, active periods, informed stops and routes)

dataSources.purpose: GTFS Realtime Trip Updates — live delays, predicted arrival/departure times and schedule changes per trip
dataSources.dataSent: No user data — the whole GTFS-RT Trip Updates protobuf feed is downloaded server-side using an API token; no end-user data is transmitted
dataSources.dataReceived: GTFS-RT FeedMessage with trip-update entities (per-stop arrival/departure delays, predicted times, schedule relationships)

dataSources.purpose: SIRI Situation Exchange (SIRI-SX) — planned and unplanned situation/disruption messages across the Swiss network
dataSources.dataSent: No user data — the complete SIRI-SX XML feeds (planned and unplanned) are downloaded server-side using an API token; no end-user data is transmitted
dataSources.dataReceived: SIRI-SX situation messages (summaries, descriptions, validity periods, affected operators, lines and stops)

dataSources.purpose: OJP Fare — optional price lookup for a planned itinerary
dataSources.dataSent: An API token plus the planned itinerary's trip and leg references (no personal data); the request is sent server-side at request time when a fare lookup is performed
dataSources.dataReceived: Fare products and price summaries for the requested itinerary legs

dataSources.purpose: Train formation / coach composition — sector positions, vehicle types, seat and accessibility details for a specific train run
dataSources.dataSent: An API token plus the operator code (EVU), operation date and train number for the journey being viewed (no personal data); the request is sent server-side at request time
dataSources.dataReceived: Train formation with vehicle order, types, lengths, seat counts, wheelchair places, toilet and low-floor flags, and per-stop sector layout

dataSources.purpose: Occupancy forecast — expected first/second-class occupancy levels for upcoming train runs
dataSources.dataSent: No user data — the occupancy forecast JSON dataset is downloaded server-side as a scheduled bulk ZIP; lookups are resolved locally by operation date and operator within the downloaded file
dataSources.dataReceived: Per-train occupancy forecasts by section, with first- and second-class expected occupancy levels and validity metadata

dataSources.purpose: Business organisations with realtime data — reference list used to label operators and detect which carriers provide real-time data
dataSources.dataSent: No user data — the go-realtime reference CSV is downloaded server-side as a scheduled bulk feed; no end-user query is forwarded
dataSources.dataReceived: Operator reference records (abbreviation, description, SBOID, organisation number, real-time data flags)

dataSources.purpose: Business organisations with SIRI-SX data — reference list used to label operators and detect which carriers provide situation-exchange data
dataSources.dataSent: No user data — the go-siri-sx reference CSV is downloaded server-side as a scheduled bulk feed; no end-user query is forwarded
dataSources.dataReceived: Operator reference records (abbreviation, description, SBOID, participant reference, situation-exchange flags)

dataSources.purpose: Master/reference data — service points, traffic points, platforms, reference points, toilets, parking, contact points and relations used to enrich stops, platforms and infrastructure
dataSources.dataSent: No user data — the master-data CSV and ZIP datasets are downloaded server-side as scheduled bulk feeds; stop and infrastructure lookups are resolved locally from the downloaded files
dataSources.dataReceived: Service and traffic points with coordinates and modes, platform and stop-point accessibility, reference points, toilets, parking lots, contact points and relations
